device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 16 GB system RAM
method: Live camera started and stopped by clicking the application UI. Same looping public factory MJPEG fixture and same fall/helmet/vest/distant-people settings. No concurrent inference benchmarks during each live session.
interpretation: Initial post-change video reached 18-19 FPS and PPE age about 2 seconds, but sustained inference remained about 0.23 FPS. The long-run comparison does not establish a recognition speed improvement. No claim of completed performance acceptance.

model_equivalence.scope: Two source frames, alternating calls with the same weights, FP32, preprocessing and NMS. This is not a full recognition-quality benchmark.

system_memory_observation.source: Read-only Windows performance counters and NtQuerySystemInformation(22). The pool tag does not identify a proven responsible application or driver.
system_memory_observation.required_follow_up: User-controlled Windows restart after saving work, then repeat UI FPS and alert-latency measurements. No system services, protections or user applications were disabled.
